derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583 (ἐκλαλέω);
def: not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable

occurrences.text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
